requirements: CL01: grass circuit forms one continuous visible loop
CL02: winter circuit forms one continuous visible loop
CL03: retain three tracks, three tickets and the existing poster integration
intent: Correct the grass and winter loop discontinuities in the 3x3 challenge poster.

edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied square 3x3 challenge poster showing three stacked scenic circuits and three ivory racing tickets.
Primary request: FIX ONLY THE TOP GRASS/FOREST CIRCUIT AND THE BOTTOM WINTER CIRCUIT. Their asphalt routes currently disappear or terminate around their middle/back sections. Redraw BOTH as physically continuous, fully visible closed-loop race tracks. Preserve the middle desert circuit and all three foreground tickets, the square composition, biome order, scale, cel-shaded style and palette.

Critical geometry: each corrected circuit must be ONE uninterrupted wide asphalt ribbon around ONE infield, a simple topological ring. The viewer must be able to follow the ENTIRE road surface around a complete lap and return to the checkerboard start without lifting a finger. Show BOTH road edges continuously for the whole lap. No dead ends, gaps, road stubs, branches, intersections, disconnected pieces, separate loops, shortcuts, bridges or tunnels. No trees, rocks, mountain, snowbank or lake may hide or cut the road at any point. Put all scenery clearly inside the loop or outside it. Keep the complete back stretch visible IN FRONT OF distant scenery so the connection is explicit; don't imply that the road continues behind a mountain. Every guardrail must follow the road edge and never cross its drivable surface.

Top GRASS/FOREST track: make a coherent broad elongated oval/kidney loop with a clearly visible continuous back straight joining the far-left curve all the way to the far-right curve. Replace the confusing center/back junction and path ends with one smooth continuous road. The entire circuit sits on lush green grass with pine trees, rock and the little lake kept in its infield or outside its outer perimeter. There is no road crossing the infield. Move or reduce scenery where necessary to expose the complete continuous asphalt loop. Preserve the single checkered start band on the front straight.

Bottom WINTER track: make a distinct broad elongated rounded loop with one gentle bend, and an uninterrupted back straight connecting the left and right ends ACROSS the entire rear side of its infield. The central mountain must sit behind that back straight or inside the loop without occluding it. Keep snowbanks and snowy pine trees off the asphalt. The lake is fully infield; no road vanishes into the water or under the snow. Both left and right road ends connect smoothly to this visible back straight and the front straight, making one complete closed loop. Preserve the single checkered start band on the front straight.

Keep the middle compacted-sand DESERT circuit and its scenery as they are. Keep EXACTLY THREE TICKETS with their existing size, position, outlines, notches, perforations and checkered flag emblems. Keep exactly three circuit islands. No new objects, vehicles, signs, labels, text, numbers, logos or watermark. Opaque background. Same square framing. Prioritize honest visible continuous track geometry over intricate scenery.
edits.review: Grass loop is visibly continuous; winter central mountain still obscures the back straight, so this draft is not integrated.

edits.review: Grass and winter asphalt each visibly trace one uninterrupted closed ring; the winter mountain is replaced by low snowy infield rocks. Three tracks and three tickets remain.
